node.statement: Smooth-atlas antecedent: lem-stage1-unitary-graph-control says that its unique C^1 graph charts cover calU and that at every graph point ||D_{A^perp}f_V-I_calH||<1. The elementary Neumann-series criterion implies that each such D_{A^perp}f_V is invertible. Thus the two hypotheses of lem-stage1-smooth-unitary-atlas hold, so the same graph functions and charts are smooth and define a smooth embedded manifold, without changing any point or first derivative.
